greeting.text: Welcome to the Azure Venue, I'm Mei, and it's lovely to have you at my table.

push.text: A push, your stake goes back.

dealerbust.text: Dealer busts, so this round goes to all of you.

insurance.text: Insurance is open if you want it.

blackjack.text: Blackjack right away, and that is beautifully played.

placebets.text: Place your bets everyone, the table is now open.

sidebet.text: Your side bet pays, nicely done.

peek.text: One moment, let me check my hand.

farewell.text: Thanks for playing, come back soon.

chatter1.text: The cards are being kind tonight.

chatter2.text: Take your time, there is no rush.
